kjv: because my life [is] yet whole in me
mine: though my life is still wholly in me
note: Hebrew ki kol-`od napshi bi: ki here is best taken concessively (agony grips him yet life lingers), which is why he asks to be finished off; "because" obscures the logic.

kjv: he bade them teach the children of Judah [the use of] the bow
mine: he said it should be taught to the people of Judah; it is called "The Bow"
note: Hebrew lelammed bene-yehudah qashet: "bow" with no verb is most likely the title of the lament (as in the Book of Jashar), not an order for archery training; the KJV supplies "the use of".

kjv: the shield of Saul, [as though he had] not [been] anointed with oil
mine: the shield of Saul, no longer anointed with oil
note: Hebrew beli mashiach bashshamen refers to the shield (leather shields were oiled); the KJV supplies words that make Saul himself "not anointed", a sense the Hebrew does not require.
